about: Player-facing release notes, oldest first. Every entry shows once in each player's notifications (after their first lesson). The newest entry is also sent as a phone alert to players who turned phone alerts on, at most once a day, unless it has "push": false. To announce an update, add an entry at the END with a new unique id. Optional "go": where tapping it leads: panel:<id> (trade, boutique, profile, seasons...), place:<name>, gallery, players, messages, balance.

updates.title: New: the Grind Grand hotel and Grind Mall
updates.body: A suite for the night and a rooftop infinity pool on the west street; the Grind Fresh supermarket, a food court and a cinema on the east street.

updates.title: New: the four seasons and climate change
updates.body: Snow in winter, orange trees in autumn. Open Seasons in the menu to see 2050 and 2100 on low and high emissions.

updates.title: New in Grind Park
updates.body: A roller coaster, two water slides, Grind Zoo with a safari tram, three holes of golf and a picnic lawn. Take the metro to Grind Park.

updates.title: New: a trip to orbit
updates.body: Grind Orbital flies from the coast past the runway. Book at the desk at the north end of the airport terminal.

updates.title: New: the party jet and the party yacht
updates.body: Charter Grind One in the airport lounge, or board the party yacht from the board by the harbour.

updates.title: New: Grind International Airport
updates.body: Take the metro to the Airport stop. Fly GA 101 in Economy, Business or First, out over the sea and across the whole city.

updates.title: New: Society Masterclasses
updates.body: Eight premium masterclasses at the Etiquette House: the wealth mindset, quiet luxury, signal and larping, fine dining, working the room, presence, first-class travel and negotiation.

updates.title: New: graduation 🎓
updates.body: Pass every course in the six Campus worlds to graduate in the Great Hall: cap and gown, your name called, a diploma to download and share.

updates.title: New: El Niño and La Niña
updates.body: Every few in-game years the Pacific warms or cools and the weather shifts. See either one now in Seasons.

updates.title: New: cliff climbing and skydiving
updates.body: At the airport: a guided 34 m sea-cliff climb past the spaceport, and a tandem skydive from the Grind Skydive desk by the hangar. Every step explained.

updates.title: New: Grind Surf School and the Art Gallery
updates.body: Learn to surf on the city beach. The Grind Art Gallery hangs famous NFTs read live from Ethereum, free to visit.

updates.title: New: your Web3 personality
updates.body: Profile reads how you play: your traits, best-fit roles and niches. Hire home staff, swim in pools, and share "A day in my Web3 life".

updates.title: New: The Pitch
updates.body: A promoter is selling a hot new coin outside the Conference Centre. Learn how a rug pull works, on practice money.

updates.title: New: invite players home
updates.body: See who is online, invite them to your home, chill, chat and dance together. Tap any resident to see their profile.

updates.title: New: My Gallery, selfies and skits
updates.body: The picture key beside the menu opens My Gallery: take screenshots and selfies, record skits with friends, then download or share them.

updates.title: New: live prices and the DeFi desk
updates.body: Coins, tokens and memecoins at real-time prices. Practise swaps, vaults, bridges, lending, borrowing and DAO votes with cash you earned.

updates.title: New: Couture in the Boutique
updates.body: Hand-beaded pearl and gold mini dresses, and jewelled bralettes with beaded mini skirts. Premium pieces.

updates.title: Smoother and sharper
updates.body: Fewer freezes, a lighter load on phones (steady 30 frames a second where a phone needs it), new cars and 4K on big screens.

updates.title: Zahra keeps you on track
updates.body: Turn on phone alerts in Messages and Zahra will remind you when your next course is waiting. Dance is now in the Players list (move to stop).

updates.title: Messages got better
updates.body: Edit or delete your own messages (tap ⋯), drag through voice notes, and see a photo before you send it. Player profiles have a fresh look, and the joystick now sits bottom right.

updates.title: Never miss a notification
updates.body: A red number on the menu key shows what is unread, and new notifications slide in at the top. Tap to open them.

updates.title: New: chats that feel like a real messaging app
updates.body: Chats and the Messages list now show each player's own character as their picture. A chat fills the screen with a slim message bar, and Add friend, Block and Report sit on the player's profile: tap their name at the top of a chat.

updates.title: New: the Grand Masjid and prayer times
updates.body: A grand masjid with a golden dome, blue tiles and two minarets now stands by the basin. The five daily prayers show in real time for your city, with Jumuʿah on Fridays: open the menu, tap Prayer, and turn on reminders so you never miss one.

updates.title: New: lovelier faces and beautiful course cards
updates.body: Every resident now has clearer skin, defined eyes and a soft natural glow, with every skin tone kept true. Each course and career has its own rich illustration, and locked courses show a preview of what is coming.
